title.zh: 由 1D 与 2D NMR 推出 C_{6}H_{10}O_{2} 的结构

prompt.zh: CDCl_{3} 中测得 ^{1}H、^{13}C、HSQC、COSY、HMBC。推出结构并归属每一个峰。
prompt.en: ^{1}H, ^{13}C, HSQC, COSY and HMBC in CDCl_{3}. Deduce the structure and assign every peak.

note.zh: 位移取自上面所列来源的实测值（CDCl_{3}）。带 ≈ 的 J 值和 C-3 的位移是文献典型值。
note.en: Shifts are the measured values from the sources listed (CDCl_{3}). J values marked ≈ and the C-3 shift are typical literature values.

answer.zh: 答案：(E)-丁-2-烯酸乙酯（巴豆酸乙酯）

title.en: Start with the degrees of unsaturation

text.zh: 动谱图之前先看分子式 C_{6}H_{10}O_{2}，它告诉我们要找几个环或双键。
text.en: Before touching a spectrum, read the formula C_{6}H_{10}O_{2}. It tells us how many rings or double bonds to look for.

so.zh: 两个不饱和度：后面必须找到两个双键，或一个环加一个双键。
so.en: Two degrees of unsaturation: we must find two double bonds, or one ring plus one double bond.

title.en: Take stock of the proton spectrum

text.zh: 氢谱可以分出 5 组信号，从低场到高场积分比为 1 : 1 : 2 : 3 : 3。
text.en: The proton spectrum separates into 5 signal groups. From low to high field the integrals are 1 : 1 : 2 : 3 : 3.

so.zh: 加起来正好 10 个 H，和分子式一致，没有多余的杂质峰需要排除。
so.en: That adds up to 10 H, matching the formula, so no signal has to be set aside as an impurity.

ask.zh: 一个 2H 四重峰加一个 3H 三重峰，J 相同。这是什么片段？
ask.en: A 2H quartet and a 3H triplet share the same J. Which fragment is this?

text.zh: δ 4.18（q，2H）和 δ 1.28（t，3H）的 J 都是 7.1 Hz。从这里开始，是因为积分、裂分和位移三样都毫不含糊。
text.en: δ 4.18 (q, 2H) and δ 1.28 (t, 3H) both show J = 7.1 Hz. We start here because integral, multiplicity and shift are all unambiguous.

rule.zh: n + 1 规律：CH_{2} 被 3 个邻位 H 裂成四重峰，CH_{3} 被 2 个邻位 H 裂成三重峰。烷基 CH_{2} 出现在 4.2 ppm 说明它直接连 O。
rule.en: n + 1 rule: three neighbours split the CH_{2} into a quartet, two neighbours split the CH_{3} into a triplet. An alkyl CH_{2} at 4.2 ppm must sit on oxygen.

so.zh: 得到第一个片段：乙氧基 –O–CH_{2}–CH_{3}。

text.zh: δ 6.98 和 δ 5.84 各 1H，都落在烯氢区，而且两者共有一个 15.5 Hz 的大偶合。
text.en: δ 6.98 and δ 5.84 are 1H each, both in the alkene region, and they share one large coupling of 15.5 Hz.

so.zh: 它们互为邻位：片段 –CH=CH–，用掉第一个不饱和度。
so.en: They are neighbours: a –CH=CH– unit, which uses the first degree of unsaturation.

title.zh: 用 J 值定双键构型
title.en: Read the alkene geometry from J

ask.zh: 15.5 Hz 的邻位偶合，是 E 还是 Z？
ask.en: A vicinal coupling of 15.5 Hz: E or Z?

text.zh: 把 δ 6.98 放大：它是 dq，先被 15.5 Hz 裂成两半，每一半再被 6.9 Hz 裂成四重峰。
text.en: Zoom into δ 6.98: a dq, split in two by 15.5 Hz, and each half split into a quartet by 6.9 Hz.

so.zh: 15.5 Hz 指向 E 构型。那个 6.9 Hz 的四重峰说明这个 CH 旁边还有一个 CH_{3}。
so.en: 15.5 Hz points to the E isomer. The 6.9 Hz quartet says this CH also has a CH_{3} next to it.

check.zh: 15.5、6.9、1.7 Hz 是反式巴豆酸酯的文献典型值。所引的实测报告只描述了裂分形状（"一大一小的偶合"），没有给出数值，所以表里写成 J ≈。
check.en: 15.5, 6.9 and 1.7 Hz are typical literature values for trans-crotonates. The cited measured report only describes the shapes (one large and one small coupling) and gives no numbers, so the table shows J ≈.

title.en: The methyl on the double bond

text.zh: δ 1.88（3H）是 dd：6.9 Hz 对上了刚才 δ 6.98 的四重峰，另一个 1.7 Hz 很小。
text.en: δ 1.88 (3H) is a dd: 6.9 Hz matches the quartet seen at δ 6.98, and the second coupling is only 1.7 Hz.

rule.zh: 1–2 Hz 的小偶合是典型的烯丙位 ^{4}J，隔着双键传到另一个烯氢。
rule.en: A small 1–2 Hz coupling is a typical allylic ^{4}J, carried across the double bond to the other olefinic H.

so.zh: 第二个片段：CH_{3}–CH=CH–，其中 δ 6.98 是挨着甲基的 H-3，δ 5.84 是 H-2。
so.en: Second fragment: CH_{3}–CH=CH–, where δ 6.98 is H-3 next to the methyl and δ 5.84 is H-2.

title.en: Carbon spectrum: count carbons, spot the functional group

text.zh: 碳谱有 6 个峰，正好 6 个碳，没有对称性。两个片段只用了 5 个碳，剩下的是 δ 166.6。
text.en: Six carbon signals for six carbons, so no symmetry. Our two fragments account for five carbons. The one left is δ 166.6.

rule.zh: 165–175 ppm 是酯或羧酸的 C=O，酮和醛要到 190 ppm 以上。
rule.en: 165–175 ppm is an ester or acid C=O. Ketones and aldehydes appear above 190 ppm.

so.zh: 酯羰基，正好用掉第二个不饱和度和第二个 O。
so.en: An ester carbonyl, which uses the second degree of unsaturation and the second oxygen.

check.zh: C-3 的 ≈144.5 是文献典型值：所引报告的碳谱表在这一行印错了。其余 5 个碳是实测值。
check.en: ≈144.5 for C-3 is a typical literature value: the cited report's carbon table is misprinted in that row. The other five carbons are measured.

title.zh: HSQC：给每个 H 找到它的 C
title.en: HSQC: give every H its carbon

text.zh: HSQC 的每个交叉峰是一对直接相连的 H 和 C。从氢向下读到碳，逐个配对。
text.en: Each HSQC cross peak is one directly bonded H–C pair. Read down from each proton to its carbon.

so.zh: 五个带氢的碳全部归属。δ 166.6 没有任何交叉峰，确认它是不带 H 的季碳。
so.en: All five protonated carbons are assigned. δ 166.6 has no cross peak at all, confirming a carbon without H.

text.zh: 读法是对角峰 → 交叉峰 → 对角峰。从 H-4（1.88）出发走到 H-3（6.98），再走到 H-2（5.84）。H-4 与 H-2 之间还有一个弱峰。
text.en: Read it as diagonal → cross peak → diagonal. From H-4 (1.88) we reach H-3 (6.98), then H-2 (5.84). A weak peak also links H-4 and H-2.

rule.zh: 对角线上方和下方的交叉峰是同一个信息，读一侧就够。
rule.en: Cross peaks above and below the diagonal carry the same information. Read one side.

so.zh: 自旋体系 A：H-4 – H-3 – H-2，和氢谱的裂分完全吻合。
so.en: Spin system A: H-4 – H-3 – H-2, in full agreement with the 1D splittings.

title.zh: COSY 也告诉我们哪里断开
title.en: COSY also shows where the chain stops

text.zh: 乙基的 4.18 只和 1.28 相关，与烯氢、甲基之间没有任何交叉峰。
text.en: The ethyl CH_{2} at 4.18 correlates only with 1.28. There is no cross peak to the olefinic protons or to the other methyl.

so.zh: 两个自旋体系互相孤立，中间隔着没有 H 的原子。要把它们接起来，必须用 HMBC。
so.en: The two spin systems are isolated, separated by atoms that carry no H. Joining them needs HMBC.

check.zh: 没看到的峰也是证据，但只有在预期峰应当很强时才可靠。
check.en: A missing peak is evidence too, but only where the expected peak should be strong.

title.en: HMBC: where the ethoxy group attaches

ask.zh: OCH_{2} 的氢如果能看到羰基碳，中间隔了几根键？
ask.en: If the OCH_{2} protons see the carbonyl carbon, how many bonds lie between them?

text.en: H-1' (4.18) shows a cross peak to δ 166.6.

rule.zh: HMBC 显示 2–3 根键的 H–C 相关。这里的路径是 H–C(1')–O–C(1)，三根键。
rule.en: HMBC shows H–C correlations over 2–3 bonds. Here the path is H–C(1')–O–C(1), three bonds.

so.zh: 乙氧基通过 O 接在羰基上：–C(=O)–O–CH_{2}CH_{3}，是乙酯。
so.en: The ethoxy group is attached to the carbonyl through O: –C(=O)–O–CH_{2}CH_{3}, an ethyl ester.

text.en: H-2 (5.84) and H-3 (6.98) both correlate to δ 166.6 as well.

rule.zh: H-2 到 C-1 是两根键，H-3 到 C-1 是三根键，都在 HMBC 的范围内。
rule.en: H-2 to C-1 is two bonds and H-3 to C-1 is three bonds. Both are within HMBC range.

so.zh: C-2 直接连羰基。两个片段在 C-1 汇合，骨架完成。
so.en: C-2 is bonded to the carbonyl. Both fragments meet at C-1 and the skeleton is complete.

check.zh: 注意：这两个交叉峰是按结构预期画的（灰色虚线圈，标 *），所引来源的正文没有逐个列出它们。位移的解释是：与 C=O 共轭使 β 位的 H-3 去屏蔽到 6.98，α 位的 H-2 留在 5.84。
check.en: Note: these two cross peaks are drawn as expected from the structure (grey dashed rings, marked *). The cited sources do not list them individually. The shifts fit: conjugation with C=O deshields the β proton H-3 to 6.98, while the α proton H-2 stays at 5.84.

title.zh: 用剩下的 HMBC 峰交叉检查
title.en: Cross-check with the remaining HMBC peaks

text.zh: 其余的峰都应当能在结构上找到 2–3 键的路径：H-4 到 C-3 和 C-2，H-2 到 C-4，H-1' 到 C-2'，H-2' 到 C-1'。其中只有 H-1'/C-2' 是来源明确列出的，其余按结构预期。
text.en: Every remaining peak should have a 2–3 bond path in the structure: H-4 to C-3 and C-2, H-2 to C-4, H-1' to C-2', H-2' to C-1'. Only H-1'/C-2' is listed explicitly by a source. The rest are expected from the structure.

so.zh: 预期的相关峰与结构没有矛盾。拿到自己的 HMBC 谱时，要逐个对一遍。
so.en: The expected correlations are consistent with the structure. With your own HMBC spectrum, tick them off one by one.

text.zh: 回头核对：C_{6}H_{10}O_{2} 的原子都用上了，两个不饱和度是 C=C 和 C=O，5 个氢信号和 6 个碳信号全部归属，J = 15.5 Hz 给出 E 构型。
text.en: Check back: every atom of C_{6}H_{10}O_{2} is used, the two degrees of unsaturation are C=C and C=O, all 5 proton and 6 carbon signals are assigned, and J = 15.5 Hz gives the E geometry.

sources.label: University of Utah, Dept. of Chemistry: ethyl trans-crotonate NMR report (500 MHz)

covers.zh: 实测：全部 5 个 ^{1}H 位移（6.978、5.841、4.180、1.877、1.282）和 5 个 ^{13}C 位移（166.58、122.79、60.08、17.92、14.26），裂分形状，以及 COSY 的 4 个相关（含 H-4/H-2 的弱峰）。该报告没有给出 J 的数值；它的碳谱表把 C-3 误印为 77.017（溶剂峰的位置），所以 C-3 的 144.5 不是出自这份实测。
covers.en: Measured: all five ^{1}H shifts (6.978, 5.841, 4.180, 1.877, 1.282) and five ^{13}C shifts (166.58, 122.79, 60.08, 17.92, 14.26), the multiplet shapes, and the four COSY correlations (including the weak H-4/H-2 peak). The report gives no J values in Hz, and its carbon table misprints C-3 as 77.017 (the solvent position), so 144.5 for C-3 is not from this measurement.

sources.label: Magritek Spinsolve case study: ethyl crotonate (60 MHz, CDCl3)

covers.zh: 实测：HMBC 中 OCH_{2} 的氢与羰基碳和 CH_{3} 碳相关；COSY 的相关。
covers.en: Measured: the HMBC correlations from the OCH_{2} protons to the carbonyl carbon and to the CH_{3} carbon; the COSY correlations.
